(i) we have cloned a novel secreted form of RAGE, hRAGEsec; (ii) the expression of this secreted isoform was detected in human brain; (iii) the interaction of RAGE with Abeta was demonstrated in human cells co-express RAGE and Abeta; (iv) we have also shown the interaction of SRA with Abeta in human cells.
a novel secreted form of RAGE was identified, that this secreted isoform is expressed in human brain and that it interacts with Abeta in a human cell system.
